newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Sterling to eye support at 2.7435 marks.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Sterling to eye support at 2.7435 marks.

text.p: Sterling is expected to slip further against the mark on Tuesday after it upside assault was interrupted just above the 2.77-mark area, said analysts.

"We have seen quite a good rebound, we have hit key resistance and are now pulling back. I expect the pullback to continue over the next day or two," said Ian Stannard, technical analyst at Chase Investment Bank.
Stannard, however, said that if sterling/mark remains perched above key support around the 2.7435 marks and avoids a stumble towards the 2.7080-mark lows, its upside potential will remain intact.

"We could see sterling pull back towards the 2.7435 or even the 2.7315-mark area in the near term, but if we can hold above here, there is still a chance for sterling to re-target the 2.7730 level," said Stannard.
He said the 2.7730-mark area is key because it was the cap on Monday's rebound and also former support in April.
At 0835 GMT sterling/mark was trading at 2.7565/75 marks against 2.7655/65 in late Europe on Monday.
Sterling/mark stumbled on Monday to seven-week lows of 2.7240 marks before recovering momentum to end the European session at the 2.7655 level.
